title: Théorie de Kumer ? + note Alexandre (bi tenseur…) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
The page has three short blocks. They continue the previous page, which treats the fundamental group of the thrice-punctured sphere with generators λ_i and a complex-conjugation-type involution ε (ε² = 1, ελ_iε⁻¹ = λ_i⁻¹). That page also treats the fundamental groupoid of a groupoid X with a group Γ acting on it, with a projection π_1(X,Γ,a) → Γ.

(1) Composition of functors given by bitorsors. A (π',π)-bitorsor _{π'}X_π defines a functor F_X : Ens(π) → Ens(π') by E ↦ X ∧^π E. Here Ens(π) is π-sets, the étale topos of a Galois category. The composite F_Y ∘ F_X, for a second bitorsor _{π''}Y_{π'}, is F_{Y ∧^{π'} X}. This holds up to canonical isomorphism: associativity of the contracted product.

(2) Classification of bitorsors. The note asks how bitorsors are classified. If X is a (π',π)-bitorsor, the left action gives an isomorphism π' ≅ ^Xπ. Here ^Xπ = Aut_π(X) is the twisted form of π (inner forms). ^Xπ is isomorphic to π, but not canonically; the identification is canonical only in Isom ext(^Xπ, π). Hence X defines an element of Isom ext(π',π) = Isom(π',π)/Int(π). Choosing a point x ∈ X gives an honest isomorphism φ with g·x = x·φ(g); changing x composes φ with an inner automorphism of π.

Grothendieck then states two results. First, π_0 of the groupoid Bit_pt(π',π) of pointed bitorsors is Isom(π',π); in fact that groupoid is discrete. Second, the forgetful map to π_0(Bit(π',π)) is surjective and is the passage to the quotient by Int(π). So π_0(Bit(π',π)) ≅ Isom(π',π)/Int(π) = Isom ext(π',π). This is Giraud's classification of bitorsors by outer isomorphisms.

(3) Coherent involutions. The data are an endofunctor F with an isomorphism μ : F² ≅ id, i.e. μ_E : F(F(E)) → E. The two maps F(μ_E) and μ_{F(E)} : F³(E) → F(E) are required to agree: Fμ = μF. This is exactly the coherence condition making (F, μ) a (pseudo-)action of Z/2 on a category, i.e. a coherent involution.

Context: this fits the Kummer / Galois-descent setting of the previous page. Complex conjugation ε acts on π_1 of P^1 − {0,1,∞}. A Galois or Z/2 action on Ens(π) by functors F_X, with X a bitorsor, gives outer actions Γ → Out(π), and an extension π_1(X,Γ,a) → Γ when the action is coherent. That is the standard passage from outer Galois actions to extensions (the arithmetic fundamental group).
errors: No mathematical errors. Small imprecision: F_Y∘F_X = F_{Y∧X} holds only up to canonical isomorphism. For pointed bitorsors the groupoid is discrete, so the π_0 statement is in fact an equivalence of groupoids with a set.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine working notes recalling standard bitorsor formalism (Giraud) and the coherence condition for a Z/2-action on a category. They are in service of the outer Galois / complex-conjugation action on π_1 of the thrice-punctured sphere. Nothing new beyond the context they give for the Kummer-theory notes.
